scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});"
scripts.dev: cross-env PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm run dev:web
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node artifacts/desktop/build-api-desktop.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/desktop run start
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node artifacts/desktop/build-api-desktop.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/farmacia run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/desktop exec electron-builder
